About HDDO

An inclusive Ethiopia where everyone can participate fully.

HDDO is an Ethiopian local non-governmental and non-profit organization established in 2026. We work with persons with disabilities, their families, communities and institutions to remove barriers and strengthen inclusion.

Our work is grounded in human rights, partnership, evidence and the leadership of people with disabilities.

Our values

  • Inclusion and equality
  • Human rights and dignity
  • Integrity and accountability
  • Transparency and partnership
  • Respect for diversity
  • Community empowerment
What we do

Practical programs that build inclusive communities.

We connect disability inclusion with the services and opportunities people need in everyday life.

Inclusive Education

Supporting children and youth with disabilities to access safe, quality and inclusive learning.

Inclusive Health Services

Promoting accessible healthcare, rehabilitation and disability-inclusive health systems.

Livelihoods and Empowerment

Strengthening skills, employment and economic opportunities for persons with disabilities.

Rights and Advocacy

Advancing disability rights, accessible policies and meaningful participation in decisions.

Inclusive Humanitarian Action

Making emergency response, social protection and resilience efforts accessible to all.

Accessible Communities

Promoting WASH, mental health support, universal design and community-based inclusion.

Our focus

Change built through local leadership and strong partnerships.

HDDO begins its work in the Somali Region and aims to expand throughout Ethiopia with communities, government institutions, OPDs and development partners.

Somali Region Our starting point and community focus
